facts.claim: Tabletop is a Google Labs experiment where groups share an online space and ask an AI agent to build the planning tools they need.
facts.verbatim_support: groups share an online space and ask an artificial intelligence agent to build the planning tools they need

facts.claim: It can create interactive trip itineraries, dinner polls, expense splitters and tournament brackets.
facts.verbatim_support: custom interactive trip itineraries, dinner polls, expense splitters, and tournament brackets

facts.claim: Users can use it at the same time, like in a Google Doc.
facts.verbatim_support: use it at the same time, like in a Google Doc

facts.claim: Tabletop is rolling out in the U.S. (18+) via waitlist.
facts.verbatim_support: Tabletop is rolling out in the U.S. (18+) via waitlist

facts.claim: Users add links, files and ideas, then prompt @tabletop or pick a starter template.
facts.verbatim_support: links, files, and ideas, then prompt @tabletop — or pick a starter template

facts.claim: Google said it would let more people in each week; no timeline or pricing given.
